description: Verify that TCP in CLOSE-WAIT returns queued data to the application on a RECEIVE call (RFC 793 §3.9 p59 Event Processing)
approach:
[Objective]
Close-wait state still has a half-open connection: the local app can read data already buffered. A PSH+FIN+ACK segment with payload drives DUT into CLOSE-WAIT and primes the read.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: PSH+FIN+ACK with payload (DUT enters CLOSE-WAIT).
3. Tester (UT) → DUT: RECEIVE call.
4. Observation: DUT acks the data, stays in CLOSE-WAIT (no FIN/RST), returns the buffered bytes.

[Pass condition]
DUT acks data + reports correct payload + remains in CLOSE-WAIT.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_dut_data_ack — no DUT ACK to received FIN+data in CW
• Fail_dut_rst_in_cw — DUT mistakenly emitted RST in CW
• Fail_dut_fin_in_cw — DUT emitted FIN in CW without CLOSE call
• Fail_no_proper_data — wrong payload reported

verdicts.Pass: DUT returned buffered data in CLOSE-WAIT — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_data_ack: No DUT ACK to received FIN+data in CW
verdicts.Fail_dut_fin_in_cw: DUT emitted FIN in CW without CLOSE
verdicts.Fail_no_proper_data: DUT did not receive proper data in CW
